newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Huan Hsin says IPO 18 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Huan Hsin says IPO 18 times subscribed.

text.p: Huan Hsin Holdings Ltd, a manufacturer and supplier of wires and cables for the telecommunications industry, said late on Monday the public offer tranche of its initial public offer (IPO) was 18 times subscribed.

Huan Hsin had offered a total of 50 million new shares at US$0.42 each, of which eight million shares were available to the general public. Five million shares were reserved for employees and 37 million were placed.
The IPO is expected to raise proceeds of about US$19.7 million to be used to set up new plants, to purchase machinery, to repay a loan from Huan Hsin Taiwan, and for working capital.
Trading on a when issued basis on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore will start on June 11.
